June 2, 2026 - Modal’s sandbox product started as a weekend prototype, but after years of hard work now handles hundreds of thousands of concurrent environments — for coding agents, RL training pipelines, and AI labs pushing the boundaries of what isolated compute needs to do.
May 22, 2026 - Its serverless infrastructure platform enables developers to deploy AI applications without having to worry about how to manage the underlying cloud servers. All of the management is handled by Modal itself,
